# Plugin CLI commands

<!-- Generated by config/scripts/generate-plugin-authoring-skill-references.mjs. Do not edit. -->

`HIVEWARD` is the HiveWard executable you resolved. Every command takes `--json`; branch on `error.code`. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 the plugin is invalid (plugin_invalid), 3 approval is needed (approval_required or approval_stale). Run `HIVEWARD <command> --help` for a command's notes.

- `HIVEWARD plugin create <dir> --template <theme|terminal-theme|icon-theme|syntax|language-pack|editor|panel|components|worker-panel> [--publisher <name>] [--id <id>] [--name <display name>] [--json]`: Scaffold a new HiveWard plugin from a template
- `HIVEWARD plugin types <dir> [--json]`: Write the TypeScript typings for HiveWard plugins into a plugin folder
- `HIVEWARD plugin test [dir] [--json]`: Run a plugin's own tests on this machine, unsandboxed: only for code you trust
- `HIVEWARD plugin check [dir] [--json]`: Validate a plugin and render each components panel once on this machine, unsandboxed: only for code you trust
- `HIVEWARD plugin validate <dir|hiveward-plugin.json|hiveward-catalog.json> [--json]`: Check a plugin folder, manifest or catalog the way HiveWard will load it
- `HIVEWARD plugin inspect <dir> [--json]`: Show what a plugin folder contributes, the access it asks for, and its content hash
- `HIVEWARD plugin release-entry <dir> [--json]`: Print the catalog release entry for a plugin folder's committed HEAD
- `HIVEWARD plugin list [--json]`: List plugins on the HiveWard host with their status and access level
- `HIVEWARD plugin logs <plugin-key> [--json]`: Print the recent log lines of a plugin
- `HIVEWARD plugin enable <plugin-key> [--approve <fingerprint>] [--json]`: Enable a plugin; code and capabilities need --approve
- `HIVEWARD plugin disable <plugin-key> [--json]`: Disable a plugin
- `HIVEWARD plugin system on [--json]`: Turn plugins on for the HiveWard host
- `HIVEWARD plugin system off [--json]`: Turn plugins off for the HiveWard host
- `HIVEWARD plugin restart <plugin-key> [--json]`: Stop a plugin's worker so its next command or event starts it fresh
- `HIVEWARD plugin dev watch <dir> [--check] [--shot <out-dir> [--shot-panel <id>]] [--approve <fingerprint>] [--json]`: Load a plugin folder, then stream its logs and reloads until Ctrl-C
- `HIVEWARD plugin dev load <dir> [--approve <fingerprint>] [--json]`: Load a plugin folder into HiveWard as a development plugin
- `HIVEWARD plugin dev reload [<dir>] [--approve <fingerprint>] [--json]`: Reload development plugins now, or one folder and re-check its approval
- `HIVEWARD plugin dev inspect <plugin-key> [--json]`: Open DevTools for a plugin's open panels and editors
- `HIVEWARD plugin dev emit <dir|plugin-key> <event> [--data <json>] [--json]`: Fire a test event at a development plugin's worker and open panels
- `HIVEWARD plugin dev request <dir|plugin-key> <name> [--data <json>] [--panel <id>] [--timeout-ms <ms>] [--json]`: Call a development plugin's worker handler the way a panel's plugin.request does
- `HIVEWARD plugin dev unload <dir|plugin-key> [--json]`: Remove a development folder from HiveWard
- `HIVEWARD plugin open <plugin-key> [--panel <id> | --editor <file>] [--json]`: Show a plugin's panel in HiveWard's right sidebar, or open a file in its editor
- `HIVEWARD plugin shot <plugin-key|dir> [--panel <id>] [--theme <light|dark>] [--width <px>] [--act '<json>' | --scenario <name>] [--out <file.png>] [--json]`: Save a PNG of a plugin panel exactly as HiveWard draws it, to look at what you built
